posts.text:
James Martin, SJ (@JamesMartinSJ)

It's hard to know what to make of the Vice President's  bizarre, almost nonsensical, comments here.  It sounds like he is equating the use of these "hideous signs" to an alternative version of the Nicene Creed.

A little background: The Nicene Creed, formulated by the Council of Nicaea in AD 325, is an essential profession of faith used by the Catholic Church (among other churches).  It is also the familiar creedal formula spoken by Catholics during Sunday Mass
